info.title: Sentinel - Robinhood Chain read-only API
info.description: Keyless, GET-only reads of Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663). Every response is block-stamped. No signing, no broadcasting, no safety verdicts.

get.summary: Read network status, an address snapshot, a transaction receipt, or search Aeon skills

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: address / token / deployer: 0x + 40 hex (deployer = for a Pons token, how many Pons v2 launches its deployer has made and which one this is; token = ERC-20 metadata + Pons v2 factory launch record: phase, base fee, creator tax, buyback, deployer holdings). transaction: 0x + 64 hex. aeon: query of 2-200 chars. Omit for network, contributions (sentinelhood's aeonfun/aeon PRs, public GitHub API), launches (12 newest Pons v2 TokenLaunched events with creator tax and phase) and shiplog (this site's recent commits).

200.description: Block-stamped result. Includes chainId, block, checkedAt, source.

502.description: Upstream RPC/Aeon unavailable, timed out, or chain mismatch
